import openai_client

class ClientTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_private_request_and_text(self):
        def fake_urlopen(request, timeout):
            self.assertEqual(request.full_url, 'https://api.openai.com/v1/responses')
            self.assertEqual(request.get_method(), 'POST')
            self.assertEqual(request.get_header('Authorization'), 'Bearer fake-key')
            self.assertEqual(timeout, 5)
            self.assertEqual(json.loads(request.data), {'model': 'gpt-4.1-mini', 'input': 'secret prompt', 'store': False})
            return io.BytesIO(json.dumps({'status': 'completed', 'output': [
                {'type': 'reasoning'},
                {'type': 'message', 'content': [{'type': 'output_text', 'text': 'Hello'}, {'type': 'output_text', 'text': ' world'}]},
            ]}).encode())
        with patch('openai_client.urllib.request.urlopen', fake_urlopen):
            self.assertEqual(openai_client.send_prompt('secret prompt', api_key='[REDACTED_SECRET]', timeout=5), 'Hello world')

    def test_http_error_hides_body_and_prompt(self):
        error = urllib.error.HTTPError('https://api.openai.com/v1/responses', 400, 'secret prompt', {}, io.BytesIO(b'secret prompt'))
        with patch('openai_client.urllib.request.urlopen', side_effect=error):
            with self.assertRaises(openai_client.OpenAIClientError) as caught:
                openai_client.send_prompt('secret prompt', api_key='[REDACTED_SECRET]')
        self.assertEqual(str(caught.exception), 'OpenAI request failed (HTTP 400)')

                openai_client.send_prompt('hello')

unittest.main(verbosity=2)
